translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Kalatia
book.title: Kalatia Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Kalatia

content: Na-ke-ivoi-an
Ginau aPol novi ahai pispisul sua. Savi avan ideh totabtabuh len ginau, aoa, aYesu Kristo mai aGot aTǝman togol tole mǝhat dan nǝmatan, arutabtabuh len ginau.
Ginau aPol, mai nǝbathudud nadǝlomian gegai, namtutos nalob̃ulat napisulan egai. Namtutosi van hǝn alat siYesu len navile gail a Kalatia.
Namtous ke aGot aTǝmadato mai Nasub̃ aYesu Kristo areviol kǝmas hǝn navoian mai gamito ale arigol nǝlomit tikad natǝm̃at.
AKristo eriŋ gai len nǝmatan m̃os b̃ilav kuv gidat dan nǝsaan sidato hǝn b̃ilav kuv gidato dan nǝmauran tosa silat ta damǝŋai. Igole husur nalǝŋonian siGot aTǝmadato.
Nǝ-sal-suhi-an tivan hǝn nǝyalyalan siGot vi sutuai sutuai! Ganan.
Na-kel-uri-an tovoi esua ŋai
Evi aGot tokis gamito hǝn mǝtb̃imaur len navoian aKristo toviol kǝmas hǝni, wake mǝtupair tutut dani van hǝn nap̃usanan totile. Nosǝhoṽut len gamito!
Nap̃usanan enan savi na-kel-uri-an tovoi ideh. Ikad nǝvanuan galevis lotogol nǝnauan samito etuhatuh, lotolǝŋon lǝb̃emǝdas na-kel-uri-an tovoi seKristo.

Be nukel mai gamit ke, avan ideh, naut kǝmas ginamit o aŋel togǝm len nǝmav, b̃ikel ur na-kel-uri-an tovoi totile dan na-kel-uri-an tovoi namttokel mai gamit tia, aGot m̃au tibar hǝni len nǝhab nǝmatan!
Hum namttokele tia, nukel tasi am ke, avan ideh b̃ikel ur na-kel-uri-an tovoi totile dan enan mǝttodǝlomi tia, aGot m̃au tibar hǝni len nǝhab nǝmatan!
Ginau nǝsahisi ke nǝvanuan gail lǝb̃ehǝhaṽur hǝn ginau. Nolǝŋoni ŋai ke aGot b̃ehǝhaṽur hǝn ginau! Nǝtahishisi ke nǝvanuan gail lǝtahǝhaṽur hǝn ginau, asike nǝtavi aslev seKristo.
AGot ekis aPol
Bathudud nadǝlomian sagw, nukel koti mai gamit ke, nǝkadun na-kel-uri-an tovoi notokel uri, savi len nǝvanuan.
Husur avan ideh sǝlavi mai ginau, saṽusani hǝn ginau. Ao, aYesu Kristo sǝb̃on, ikel vǝhoti mai ginau.
Nokǝmaienan husur mǝtosǝsǝloŋ lǝboi tia naṽide hǝn nǝmauran sagw nǝboŋ notohusur naṽide hǝn nalotuan seJu gail. Ginau aPol, nomǝdas tabtab hǝn alat siGot hǝn lǝb̃imasig.
Len naṽide hǝn nalotuan seJu gail, ginau nosǝhor naJu isob̃ur len naur hagw. Nudaŋ habat len naṽide setǝmagw gail ta sutuai.

Len navoian toviol kǝmas hǝni, aGot ilekis hǝn ginau, ekis ginau nǝboŋ notopat len nabǝhaṽun anagw sal. Beti aGot ehǝhaṽur hǝn togol ke nolǝboi p̃arp̃ar hǝn aNatun san hǝn nǝb̃ikel uri mai alat lǝsavi Ju. Nǝboŋ togol tomaienan, nǝsǝsaṽsaṽut hǝn nǝb̃isor kitevi mai avan ideh,
nǝsavi mǝhat vi Jerusalem hǝn nǝb̃eris alat lotovi ahai pispisul gail a m̃o hǝn ginau. Aoa, novi tut vi Arapia, beti notǝlmam vi lan naut a Tamaskus.
Husur nasihau totor notǝlmam vi Jerusalem hǝn nǝb̃elǝboi aPita mai nǝb̃inau sǝhot nǝsa b̃ikel mai ginau. Ale nutoh maii len nǝmariboŋ tovi 15.
Nǝsaris ahai pispisul ideh am, be aJemes aṽan Nasub̃ ŋai.
Nǝsa nototosi van hǝn gamito ekitin. Len nǝhon aGot nukele, nǝsaliboŋ.
Beti husur nǝboŋ enan novi lan naut a Siria mai a Silisia.
Be alat seKristo len naut a Jutea lǝsabubur mai ginau, lǝsalǝboi ginau.
Losǝsǝloŋ hǝn na-kel-uri-an ŋai toke, “Atenan tomǝdas tabtab hǝn ginamit a m̃o, gagai ikel ur nadǝlomian egaii tomǝdasi a m̃o.”
Imaienan lusal suh aGot bathut nǝsa togole len ginau.

footnotes.text: 1.18 Uman 9.26-30. Len nasoruan ta Kris ike aKefas, tovi nahǝsan aPita len nasoruan ta Aram.
